question: 2026年上半年每个月的净销额
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026 
      AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 6
    GROUP BY d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    year_month AS 月份,
    net_sales AS 净销额
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY year_month

question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH outlet_region AS (
    SELECT 
        o.outlet_id,
        o.region
    FROM dim_outlet o
),
sku_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_id,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_id, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sku_name,
        total_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn
    FROM sku_sales
)
SELECT 
    region AS 大区,
    sku_name AS 单品名称,
    total_qty AS 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region

question: 各渠道净销额占全渠道净销额合计的比例
error_detail: Binder Error: Table "s" does not have a column named "campaign_id"
sql:
WITH channel_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS channel_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN mkt_campaign c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY c.channel
)
SELECT 
    channel,
    channel_net_amount / SUM(channel_net_amount) OVER () AS 净销额占比
FROM channel_sales
ORDER BY channel

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.brand AS 品牌,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS 品牌净销额
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY p.brand
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS 总净销额
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    bs.品牌
FROM brand_sales bs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE bs.品牌净销额 / ts.总净销额 > 0.10

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数量
FROM (
    SELECT o.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (
        SELECT AVG(total_net)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(s2.net_amount) AS total_net
            FROM fact_sales s2
            JOIN dim_outlet o2 ON s2.outlet_id = o2.outlet_id
            JOIN dim_date d2 ON s2.date_key = d2.date_key
            WHERE d2.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
            GROUP BY o2.outlet_id
        ) AS avg_table
    )
) AS high_performers

    p.category AS 品类,
    p.sku_name AS 单品,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY p.category, p.sku_name
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY p.category, 销量 DESC

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category AS 品类,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.year_month = '2026-08' THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END) AS 八月销量,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.year_month = '2026-07' THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END) AS 七月销量
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT 品类
FROM monthly_sales
WHERE 八月销量 > 七月销量

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY dl.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        net_sales,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region AS 大区,
    net_sales AS 净销额,
    running_total / grand_total AS 累计占比
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 有多少个终端和单品的铺货组合在2026年8月完全没有销售
sql:

FROM rel_outlet_sku ro
WHERE ro.listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
  AND (ro.delisted_date IS NULL OR ro.delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')

    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE s.outlet_id = ro.outlet_id
      AND s.sku_id = ro.sku_id
      AND d.full_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
      AND d.full_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  )

question: 哪些业务代表的有效拜访次数高于平均值
sql:
WITH rep_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        r.rep_id,
        r.rep_name,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN fv.is_planned = TRUE AND fv.is_executed = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS valid_visit_cnt
    FROM fact_visit fv
    JOIN dim_rep r ON fv.rep_id = r.rep_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON fv.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.rep_name
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(valid_visit_cnt) AS avg_valid_visit
    FROM rep_avg
)
SELECT 
    ra.rep_name
FROM rep_avg ra
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ra.valid_visit_cnt > oa.avg_valid_visit
ORDER BY ra.rep_name

question: 2026年各月净销额及占全年的比例
sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    d.year_month AS 月份,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS 月净销额
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year = 2026
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS 全年净销额
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year = 2026
)
SELECT 
  m.月份,
  m.月净销额,
  ROUND(m.月净销额 * 100.0 / t.全年净销额, 2) AS 占全年比例
FROM monthly m
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY m.月份

question: 各品牌的销额排名名次以及与第一名的销额差额
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.brand AS 品牌,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS 品牌销额
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY p.brand
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        品牌,
        品牌销额,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 品牌销额 DESC) AS 排名
    FROM brand_sales
)
SELECT 
    品牌,
    排名,
    品牌销额 - FIRST_VALUE(品牌销额) OVER (ORDER BY 排名) AS 与第一名差额
FROM ranked
ORDER BY 排名

question: 2026年8月新品销额占各大区总销额的比例
sql:
WITH new_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS new_product_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 8
      AND p.is_new_product = TRUE
    GROUP BY o.region
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 8
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
    t.region AS 大区,
    ROUND(n.new_product_amount / t.total_amount * 100, 2) AS 新品销额占比
FROM total_sales t
LEFT JOIN new_product_sales n ON t.region = n.region
ORDER BY t.region

question: 2026年各月活跃终端数及相比上月的变化
sql:
WITH monthly_active AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id) AS active_outlets
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026
    GROUP BY d.year_month
)
SELECT
    ma.year_month AS 月份,
    ma.active_outlets AS 活跃终端数,
    ma.active_outlets - LAG(ma.active_outlets) OVER (ORDER BY ma.year_month) AS 相比上月变化
FROM monthly_active ma
ORDER BY ma.year_month

question: 销额前十的终端合计占总销额的比例
sql:
WITH top_outlets AS (
    SELECT s.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    ORDER BY SUM(s.net_amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10

FROM fact_sales all_s
JOIN dim_date d ON all_s.date_key = d.date_key

WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

question: 有多少家经销商的促销费用高于所有经销商的平均费用

FROM (
    SELECT dl.dealer_id
    FROM fact_promo_cost pc
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON pc.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id

question: 华东区销额前五的城市及其在全国的排名
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    o.city AS 城市,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS 销售额
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY o.city
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    城市,
    销售额,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 销售额 DESC) AS 全国排名

east_top5 AS (

  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

question: 2026年8月碳酸饮料的动销率是多少
sql:
WITH outlet_sku AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT outlet_id, sku_id
    FROM rel_outlet_sku
    WHERE listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      AND (delisted_date IS NULL OR delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.outlet_id, s.sku_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
      AND s.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM dim_product WHERE category = '碳酸饮料')
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ms.outlet_id * 100000 + ms.sku_id) * 1.0 / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT os.outlet_id * 100000 + os.sku_id), 0) AS 动销率
FROM outlet_sku os
LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON os.outlet_id = ms.outlet_id AND os.sku_id = ms.sku_id
WHERE os.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM dim_product WHERE category = '碳酸饮料')

question: 2026年8月的净销额同比去年同期增长了多少
sql:
WITH sales_current AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month = 8
),
sales_previous AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.month = 8
)
SELECT 
    (current_net_sales - previous_net_sales) / previous_net_sales * 100 AS 同比增长率
FROM sales_current, sales_previous

question: 2026年8月各渠道的动销率是多少
sql:
SELECT 
  s.outlet_id AS 渠道,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.qty > 0 THEN s.sku_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ros.sku_id) AS 动销率
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT dl.region,
           SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY dl.region
),
previous_period AS (
    SELECT dl.region,
           SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY dl.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(cp.region, pp.region) AS 大区,
    (cp.current_net_sales - pp.previous_net_sales) / NULLIF(pp.previous_net_sales, 0) AS 净销额同比增长率
FROM current_period cp
FULL OUTER JOIN previous_period pp ON cp.region = pp.region
ORDER BY 大区

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
error_detail: Binder Error: Table "ec_traffic" does not have a column named "platform"
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ec_traffic.platform AS 渠道,
    d.year_month AS 月份,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ec_order.order_no) AS 订单数,
    SUM(ec_order.pay_amt) AS 销售额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ec_order.member_id) AS 购买人数
  FROM ec_order
  JOIN ec_traffic ON ec_traffic.stat_date = CAST(ec_order.order_time AS DATE)
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.full_date = CAST(ec_order.order_time AS DATE)
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-08', '2025-08')
  GROUP BY ec_traffic.platform, d.year_month
),
shop_count AS (
  SELECT 
    ec_traffic.platform AS 渠道,
    d.year_month AS 月份,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ec_traffic.shop_code) AS 门店数
  FROM ec_traffic
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.full_date = ec_traffic.stat_date
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-08', '2025-08')
  GROUP BY ec_traffic.platform, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
  m.渠道,
  (m.销售额 / s.门店数) AS 单店产出,
  ((m.销售额 / s.门店数) - (m_prev.销售额 / s_prev.门店数)) / (m_prev.销售额 / s_prev.门店数) AS 同比变化率
FROM monthly_sales m
JOIN shop_count s ON m.渠道 = s.渠道 AND m.月份 = s.月份
JOIN monthly_sales m_prev ON m.渠道 = m_prev.渠道 AND m_prev.月份 = '2025-08'
JOIN shop_count s_prev ON m.渠道 = s_prev.渠道 AND s_prev.月份 = '2025-08'
WHERE m.月份 = '2026-08'

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH cost_data AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4) THEN '2025H2'
             WHEN d.year = 2026 AND d.quarter IN (1, 2) THEN '2026H1'
        END AS period,
        SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS total_cost
    FROM fact_promo_cost pc
    JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE (d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4))
       OR (d.year = 2026 AND d.quarter IN (1, 2))
    GROUP BY period
),
sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4) THEN '2025H2'
             WHEN d.year = 2026 AND d.quarter IN (1, 2) THEN '2026H1'
        END AS period,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE (d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter IN (3, 4))
       OR (d.year = 2026 AND d.quarter IN (1, 2))
    GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
    (c2026.total_cost / NULLIF(s2026.total_sales, 0)) - (c2025.total_cost / NULLIF(s2025.total_sales, 0)) AS 费效比提升幅度
FROM cost_data c2026
JOIN sales_data s2026 ON c2026.period = '2026H1' AND s2026.period = '2026H1'
CROSS JOIN cost_data c2025
CROSS JOIN sales_data s2025
WHERE c2025.period = '2025H2' AND s2025.period = '2025H2'
